newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine president demands 1997 budget by end-April.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine president demands 1997 budget by end-April.

text.p: Ukraine's parliament must accept the long overdue 1997 budget and pass a package of tax reforms by the end of April, a spokesman for President Leonid Kuchma quoted him as saying on Thursday.
Serhiy Kutsy told reporters Kuchma had ordered Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko to appear in parliament on April 1 and relay Kuchma's orders.
Approval of the budget, and the tax reform package underpinning it, should clear the way for Ukraine to receive a $2.5 to $3 billion International Monetary Fund credit.
Kuchma noted the importance of repealing widespread benefits and perks, such as free travel on public transportation and subsidised rent, which Ukraine inherited from the Soviet system.
Ukraine has never met its January 1 budget deadline since it won independence from the Soviet Union in 1991.
